name: ASK-SEND — send queued thesis-check replies inside the latest deal thread (weekdays 11:00 IST)

// LIVE since 17 Sep 2026 (user approved). dry: true = check only. max_per_run caps daily sends.
return [{ json: { dry: false, max_per_run: 40 } }];
const a=$('Select').all().map(i=>i.json).filter(x=>x.kind==='send'&&x.mb==='2');return a.length?a.map(j=>({json:j})):[{json:{skip:true}}];

const a=$('Select').all().map(i=>i.json).filter(x=>x.kind==='send'&&x.mb==='5');return a.length?a.map(j=>({json:j})):[{json:{skip:true}}];
const j=$('Results').first().json;return j.data.length?[{json:{cells:j.data.length}}]:[];
